desc:
PvP street fighting in a living Japanese city. Read the punch, parry it, hit back.

 FIGHT: Every hit can be parried. Block, dash, combo and land the heavy. No levels to grind, timing wins.
 YOUR FIGHTER: Roll your height, your style (Boxing, Taekwondo, Judo and more) and a trait that changes how you fight.
 RANK: Win street fights and climb the city's fight board.
 WORK: 8 jobs to earn yen. Cook ramen, roll sushi, run the store, pump gas, sing karaoke or deliver on your bike.
 RIDE: From a city bicycle to superbikes, plus a tuk-tuk that seats your friends and plays your music.
 PHONE AND GANGS: Call people, post on the city feed, start a gang with your friends.

Plays on PC, phone and tablet.

👍 Like and favorite for more updates.
